name: Canada.ca
body: Language alternates in both directions, a sitemap, HSTS, and alt text on every image. But the English home page sends no content security policy and no Referrer-Policy, so nothing limits where scripts load from.
lesson: Start with a report-only CSP, read the reports for a few weeks, then enforce it. Add a Referrer-Policy too.
summary: www.canada.ca scores 63 out of 100 (D). 3 checks fail now, 23 are at risk, and 16 pass. Fix first: the start page tells search engines not to index it.

fix.title: The start page tells search engines not to index it
fix.fix: Remove noindex from pages that should be found, and keep it only on private or duplicate pages.

fix.title: 1 cookie is sent without Secure, and 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without Secure: AWSALB. Without HttpOnly: aka-ca-site-token. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on /, /en.html, /fr.html and 16 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 19 pages read. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: AI crawlers see an almost empty start page
fix.evidence: The HTML carries 162 characters of readable text. Most AI crawlers do not run JavaScript.
fix.fix: Render the main content on the server or pre-render it at build time.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 19 pages read.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 19 pages read.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Language alternates point at each other
